title: React 19 hooks
subtitle: Five small, working examples. Read the comments in each component to learn how the hook behaves.

actionState.title: Forms with Server Actions
actionState.description: The form posts to a Server Action. useActionState keeps the returned state; useFormStatus lets the submit button know the form is pending.
actionState.label: Your name

optimistic.title: Optimistic updates
optimistic.description: The note appears instantly while the server is still saving it. Type a text containing "fail" to see the automatic rollback.
optimistic.label: Note
optimistic.hint: The server takes ~1 second to answer.

use.title: Reading a promise with use()
use.description: The Server Component starts a slow request and passes the promise down. The client reads it with use() while Suspense shows a fallback.

transition.title: Async transitions
transition.description: startTransition accepts an async function in React 19: isPending stays true until the server answers, and the page stays interactive.

deferred.title: Deferred values
deferred.description: The list is deliberately slow. useDeferredValue keeps typing responsive and renders the list with the new text in the background.
deferred.upToDate: The list is up to date.
